hunks.sol: “I wondered if perhaps you were actually thinking of taking me as a real Disciple, or something like that. It’s nonsense, so you don’t have to answer. Hahaha.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang remained silent for a long while despite my calling him, then tossed out a single sentence.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang remained silent for a long time. Then he tossed out a single sentence.

hunks.baseline: “Would that be a problem?”
hunks.sol: “Why not?”

hunks.baseline: “What would?”
hunks.sol: “Why not what?”

hunks.baseline: “I asked if there was something wrong with this old man being your master.”
hunks.sol: “Why can’t this old man be your master?”

hunks.baseline: *What the hell was this atmosphere?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell was with this atmosphere?*
